On a one-year placement, 'half a year done so far'; Placement year correct.
Repeatedly a 'designer-y person' on a design course; Design & Technology correct.
'still a year in work... never be a bad thing... full time work' strongly endorses work experience value.
'look really good on anyone's CV' maps to improved job chances; agree fits.
'helped because I've seen different areas I could work in' supports deciding future direction.
Quote ('lot of experience... confident talking to people') is personal development, not 'idea of what industry is really like'; same quote as perdevel, no industry-construct evidence.
'a lot more confident... presentation skills got loads better' strongly supports personal development.
'a bit, but not loads... not as designery as I thought' supports limited theory application; disagree reasonable.
'can never be a bad thing... full time work' strongly rejects 'nothing to gain'; strongly disagree correct.

Confidence gains attributed to the PLACEMENT, not the COURSE; variable is 'the course develops interpersonal skills'. Coder's own note admits misattribution.
Explicitly no longer wants a design career, leans to marketing (non-engineering); code 10 fits.
Strongly dislikes desk-bound working, values manager's leniency; work environment matters. Indirect but adequate; keep medium.
'old men, not much to talk about... thing that bothers me the most' shows the people she works with matter.
'work from home some days... quite cool' indicates flexible working valued; indirect, low confidence appropriate.
